criteria.description: Artifact details expose the SBOM tab and render attestation format, generator, storage, hashes, NTIA compliance, and packages when SBOM data exists.
Artifact SBOM tab renders a clear empty state when no SBOM or attestation is available.
Policy creation visual builder can add SBOM-related rules and preserve them when switching to JSON editor.
Policy creation rejects visual-builder submission without at least one rule.
Events page can display and filter canonical SBOM attestation/index events without showing non-SBOM events.
